omissions: Rich formatting, layout, comments, tracked changes, drawings and embedded objects are not preserved.
No OCR or vision was performed; PDF imports use only the text layer.
Tables, merged cells, date formatting, headers and footers are simplified or omitted; dates become ISO text. XLSX numbers use spreadsheet numeric precision; caches are omitted from exported XLSX.
Formulas are not evaluated; caches are imported or user-supplied observations, never computed results.
Chart pixels omit input annotations and source details; inspect this manifest and original input. Numeric rows are decimal results; plot coordinates use floating point.
fidelity: Editable values and plain paragraphs; constrained layout; no office-suite fidelity.
